description: Record actual token usage for a completed LLM call. Cost is computed server-side from current pricing, never trusted from the caller — this is the 'actual spend' counterpart to estimate_cost's hypothetical numbers. Usage is attributed to your org. Resubmitting the same request_id for the same org is a no-op. Use when the user wants to log or track real LLM spend, not just estimate it. Requires your service API key on the MCP connection (x-api-key or Authorization: Bearer); org_id defaults to, and must match, that key's org.

input_tokens.description: Number of input tokens actually used

model_name.description: Name of the LLM model that was called

occurred_at.description: Unix timestamp when the call happened (default: now)

org_id.description: Optional organisation ID to attribute this usage to. Defaults to, and must match, the org of the service key on the MCP connection

output_tokens.description: Number of output tokens actually used

request_id.description: Optional idempotency key — resubmitting the same value is a no-op

session_id.description: Optional session ID to tag this event with, so it can later be grouped and retrieved via analyze_session_usage — e.g. a bounded burst of calls like a coding-agent run or a chat session

name: record_usage
